description.en: Sets up the active camera at one of several predefined match-view position presets (e.g. CAMERA_CENTER, CAMERA_MY_GOAL, CAMERA_OTHER_GOAL), initializing camera control first. Each preset's coordinates can optionally be rescaled for technique cutscenes via ToScaleWazaMap.
Preset camera position constant to use (e.g. CAMERA_CENTER, CAMERA_MY_GOAL, CAMERA_OTHER_GOAL, CAMERA_MY_BENCH, CAMERA_OTHER_BENCH).
When true, rescales the preset's coordinates via ToScaleWazaMap for use on a technique map.
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

examples.case: Setting the camera to a preset position (real usage, e.g. from ev44030030.nut)
examples.code:
// Set the camera to the "my bench" preset position
CamSettingBattlePosRef(CAMERA_MY_BENCH);

examples.case: Setting the camera to a preset position rescaled for a technique map
examples.code:
// Set the camera to the center-field preset position, rescaled for a technique cutscene
CamSettingBattlePosRef(CAMERA_CENTER, true);
